description: A second .cho file, "lorem-ipsum-oud.cho" (a copy of the song), in the folder of lorem-ipsum, listed in the manifest. STR-06, not STR-08: STR-08 is about files that are not song files (M-17).

format_1_1.note: The copy's id differs from its file name (S004), so the copy is skipped; a skipped file takes no part in the duplicate-id check (song format v0.23, 11.3 S005), so lorem-ipsum.cho itself imports and its setlist entry is found.
